profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: I believe that software is an incredibly powerful tool that allows us to improve the lives of people all across the globe in a matter of seconds.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
-Developed an algorithm that helped to update the New Account Deal Flow used by West Zone executive to review the live status of each account. Also, collaborated on a similar project with the Chicago team.
-Performed reviews for 50+ new business accounts to assess the feasibility of underwriting these accounts next year.
-Conducted hazard analysis and identified loss exposures to determine if an account is a good risk opportunity.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Research on orthotropic material properties. 
Worked on simulations of boundary conditions on Orthotropic homogenous materials with stiff inclusions. 
Used forward problem simulated data on inverse FEM problem solution to retrieve material properties and geometry of the studied sample.
Redesigned experimental models, as well as the implemented code for simulation of data.

honors.title: Codepath.org Mobile App Development Certificate
honors.description: Outstanding completion of Android Mobile App Development course.

projects.title: Itinerary Web App
projects.description: Team project combining three different APIs (DarkSky, Yelp, and Bing Maps) to create a travel itinerary. URL: tx.ag/SightTheCity

projects.title: IMDb Database
projects.description: Created IMDb database from .tsv files and created GUI to submit different queries to retrieve data.
